description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of operation logs for a task instance
description_zh: 分页获取指定任务实例的操作日志列表
name: ListTaskInstanceOperationLogs

parameters.description_en: The operation date, accurate to the day. The default value is the current day. You can query only the operation logs generated within the previous 31 days. This value is a UNIX timestamp.
parameters.description_zh: 操作日期（精确到天），默认查询当天。支持查询过去31天内的操作日志。格式为时间戳。
parameters.help_en: The operation date, accurate to the day. The default value is the current day. You can query only the operation logs generated within the previous 31 days. This value is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 操作日期（精确到天），默认查询当天。支持查询过去31天内的操作日志。格式为时间戳
parameters.name: date

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.
parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number
